descriptions.text: Brighten someone's day with the Un goet de vacances Stamp Set. Ink up one of these retro swimsuits for a solid image and pair it with a fun summertime message. Or use all four prints to create a versatile beachy background. Go for a two-toned look by getting out your markers and coloring directly on the stamp to create a print that's just your style. Dive deeper and try a new stamping technique. Mix and match swimsuit tops and bottoms by using the masking technique. Stamp the swim top of one image, cover with tracing paper so you can align the images, and then stamp the swim bottom you like. So many possibilities! Get creative with color and try for a soft gradient ombre look. Using a sponge, gradually fade from one color to another-like a fiery red and orange sunset or purple and blue magical mermaid moment. Bring a touch of paradise to every design! Also available in English.

descriptions.text: If you want to use traditional greetings on your Christmas or holiday cards, the Banderoles de Noel Stamp Set is what you're looking for! Most of the words are on separate stamps, so you can combine them how you want. And because they're on clear photopolymer stamps, it's easy to line them up. Say "Meilleurs veux " or "Joyeux Noel", "Joyeuses Fetes" or "Bonne annee". Create the greeting you like, then frame it in a flowing banner. Some of the banners are large enough to be all you need on a card front or note card. But if you want more, combine the banner greetings with the greenery images in this set. Stamp boughs of holly, a pine branch garland, or leafy sprigs. With so many options in one set, you can't go wrong! Also available in English.

descriptions.text: Every homemade gift, treat, and goodie bag deserves a cute tag to go along with it. And with the Handmade Wishes Stamp Set, you can create the most adorable, on-trend tags (and even cards!) for the holidays and year-round. Each sentiment is small enough to fit within the border stamp, and there's even room to mix and match a few. If you made Christmas cookies to send as gifts, you could stamp a gingerbread man and the sentiment, "Baked with Love." Or try layering the solid "Joy," "Peace," and "Love" stamps with their coordinated outline versions. Whether you're wishing someone Happy Holidays, Merry Christmas, or a Happy New Year, or simply embellishing your design with a few snowflakes or hearts-you'll find yourself reaching for this stamp set again and again. Also available in French.

descriptions.text: Create the quintessential Christmas treat with the Gingerbread House Dies. Add layers of detail with 18 different dies to choose from, making one-of-a-kind sugary designs. descriptions.text: They're cheerful, loyal, and ready to help you send Christmas greetings! The three Scottish Terriers in the Christmas Scottie Stamp Set are eager to adorn your handmade cards and gift tags. Choose your pup, then dress it up in festive finery by stamping the bow of your choice. Giving a gift? Add a bow to the two-line image to create a little present. You can use this set for Christmas cards and tags, but it also includes sentiments you can use all year long. Here's something fun you can try with this set-use the kissing technique to create a plaid scottie dog (or bow). The kissing technique is easy and fun: Stamp the plaid background stamp in your favorite color ink, then "kiss" (press) the scottie dog stamp onto the inked plaid stamp. The scottie dog stamp will pick up the ink and design from the plaid stamp, and you'll end up with an adorably plaid puppy!

descriptions.text: Create warm and wonderful memories with the Snowman Magic Stamp Set. Not only do you get six seasonal sentiments-"Thanks snow much!"-but you can also build your own versatile scenes and snowmen. With over 20 stamps to mix and match, you can get creative in bringing your snowman to life! The photopolymer stamps are clear, making it easy to line up over what you've already stamped; no need for guesswork. The open line-art style means you can leave your designs in black and white, or add touches of color using your favorite coloring techniques. Looking for a craft you can do with the kids? Have fun making as many unique snowmen (and snowwomen!) as you like. But this set isn't just for the snow-using the fine grain stamp, you can turn your snowman into a sandman! Add some sunglasses and your sandman is ready to beat that heat. With so many ways to make each creation unique, this is a stamp set you'll keep coming back to.
